newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian socialists to form cabinet despite protests.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian socialists to form cabinet despite protests.

text.p: Bulgaria's ruling Socialists will form a new government next week despite 27 days of opposition protests demanding immediate elections, Socialist party leader Georgi Parvanov said on Saturday.
He said Nikolai Dobrev, the Socialist nominated to form the new cabinet, would be prime minister if the government wins the approval of the 240-seat parliament.
"I'm sure next week Bulgaria will have a new government but it is hard to predict what the future of this government will be," Parvanov said in an interview with state television.
He said the Socialists could count on 122 votes in the parliament, less than their 125 seats but an absolute majority and able to win the confidence vote.

Students and opposition parties have vowed to intensify a 27-day protest campaign, and disrupt Bulgaria's road and rail links further, if the Socialists form a new government instead of opting for immediate elections.
